content: PartyKit was acquired by Cloudflare in April 2024 and continues to operate, now integrated into Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects with no extra PartyKit-specific charge beyond standard Cloudflare Workers usage (generous free tier, Durable Objects available on Workers Free plan as of April 2025 changelog). Workers/Durable Objects do not sleep the way Render's free tier does, avoiding the cold-start risk, but require learning the Durable Objects storage/room lifecycle model, adding build-time risk for a one-week deadline.
